defective_pattern: Missing explicit blank line before headings, presence of trailing blank lines after headings, and failure to filter out non-table narrative/scoring text in the Appendices section.
why_defective: Violates strict academic formatting standards and pollutes the Appendices with irrelevant scoring logic instead of strictly containing only the questionnaire table and title.
observed_symptoms: Headings generated without preceding blank lines.
Trailing blank lines inserted after headings in DOCX.
Narrative text and scoring logic leak into the 'پیوست' (Appendices) section.
corrective_remedy: Enforce strict blank line injection before headings and zero trailing blank lines after headings. Apply a strict filter during Appendices compilation to strip all narrative and scoring text, preserving strictly the questionnaire title and table.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect headings with no preceding blank lines or trailing empty paragraphs, and detect narrative paragraphs in the Appendices section.
